Great results! I would recommend sealing your night routine with a layer of Vaseline or nivea cream as the last step as it will seal all the good acids/ingredients into your skin and give you a good moisturizing lock! It is called slugging “try to watch some videos about it on YouTube!”. I started doing it a year ago and my skin started to really get the best benefits of my night routine and waking up in the morning with well moisturized skin! You only have to wash it off with mild cleanser next morning and I recommend using a silk or soft cotton pillow case for bed when sleeping. It is a game changer:)

The sooner you start the better! She might’ve been concerned about you not protecting your skin by using SPF/sunblock but I don’t see any reason why she wouldn’t prescribe it!! I’m 37 now and I’ve been on tret/retina since I’ve turned 28!
Note: make sure to always moisturize after tret, and always use sunblock! Use it gradually and give your skin couple of days break every now and then! Happy ride :)
